references.observed: The photographs distinguish the high steel hoist gallery over rounded concrete noses from the head regulator with a row of enclosed drum housings and its own road crossing.
Downward view of the raised gate gallery, repeated open steel trestles, concrete toes, rail deck and red edge rail.
Aerial view shows the main barrage road and railway at the west end, the adjoining salmon-colored control building and the separate head regulator aligned toward the feeder.
The project describes 112 main barrage gates, the two-tier fish-lock gates at bay 25, and 11 three-tier head regulator gates.
The existing navigation lock has a roughly 180 m chamber, 25.145 m width and miter gate hardware. Its alignment is taken from the separate native PMTiles chamber polygon.
